title: Fix JSON backup restore misread as ZIP
summary: JSON backups failed restore with JSZip 'Can't find end of central directory' because CORS hid Content-Disposition and the file was saved as *.zip; unpack then trusted the extension. Unpack now uses ZIP magic bytes (with JSON fallback), CORS exposes Content-Disposition, and the SPA falls back to .json from Content-Type.
testFocus: Export format=JSON then restore that file (even if named .zip) succeeds
Newly exported JSON downloads with .json name after FE+BE deploy
productionChecks: After Pages + Render redeploy: JSON backup ? restore merge succeeds without JSZip central directory error

deploy.expected: Push main ? GitHub Pages FE + Render BE redeploy

asIs: JSON content saved/uploaded as *.zip was forced through JSZip and failed.
toBe: Non-PK buffers parse as JSON; ZIP only when magic bytes match; download filename uses Content-Type/CORS headers.
